title: SimAI: Mechanistic User Simulation through Psychological Network Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. However, existing simulators largely overlook the psychological mechanisms that drive user behavior. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. To support this approach, we construct PSYCHE, a dataset of 18,576 profile-network pairs derived from 516 psychotherapy cases. Automatic evaluations show that SimAI achieves greater simulation and behavioral diversity than existing patient simulators while maintaining strong profile alignment. translated_title: SimAI：基于心理网络模型的机制性用户模拟
translated_abstract: 现实的用户模拟使得在直接实验成本高昂或可能带来潜在危害的情况下研究人机交互成为可能。然而，现有的模拟器在很大程度上忽视了驱动用户行为的心理机制。我们提出了SimAI，一个用于机制性用户模拟的框架，它通过建模心理因素之间的相互作用来塑造用户响应。为了克服监督开放式行为这一挑战，我们提出了一种图重构目标，根据模拟对话反映潜在心理关系的程度来提供图级别的奖励。为支持这一方法，我们构建了PSYCHE数据集，其中包含从516个心理治疗案例中提取的18,576个档案-网络对。自动评估显示，SimAI在保持较强档案一致性的同时，比现有的患者模拟器实现了更高的模拟多样性和行为多样性。在一项与30名心理健康专业人士开展的交互式研究中……
tldr: SimAI是一个基于心理网络模型的机制性用户模拟框架，通过图重构目标建模心理因素间的相互作用，并借助PSYCHE数据集实现了比现有患者模拟器更高的多样性和档案一致性。
en_tdlr: SimAI is a mechanistic user simulation framework based on psychological network models that employs a graph reconstruction objective to model how psychological factors shape user responses, achieving greater diversity and profile alignment than existing patient simulators on the PSYCHE dataset.
